data.raw_text:
A new bridal fair is set to redefine the wedding expo experience in Metro Manila. Merkado Market, together with Nice Print Photo and Manila Craft, is launching “Tadhana Bridal Fair” on July 11 to 12, 2026 at the SMX Convention Center in SM Aura Premier, Taguig City.

Unlike traditional bridal fairs known for crowded bazaars and overwhelming vendor selections, Tadhana aims to offer a more intentional and curated experience for modern couples. Organizers say the event focuses on “quality over quantity,” connecting celebrants with carefully selected creatives and suppliers that match today’s aesthetic-forward and trust-driven wedding culture.

Named after the Filipino word for destiny, Tadhana Bridal Fair promises a fresh approach through vetted vendors, balanced category selections, and a more personalized atmosphere designed for meaningful connections rather than just foot traffic. The event is open to brides, couples, and milestone celebrants looking to build their dream event team.
